properties.title: Cook Islands administrative and jurisdictional boundaries (long table)
properties.description: All boundary levels for Cook Islands, from the EEZ to the finest published level, stacked in one table (one row per unit per level). Sources: Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), "Cook Islands Island Polygons (Topo50 series; 1:25k Zone4/Zone3 and 1:50k Zone4/Zone3)" (cok-linz-island-polygons-topo); Pacific Community (SPC) Geoscience, Energy and Maritime Division (PCRAFI); source PopGIS / Cook Islands Statistics Office, "PCRAFI 2010 population exposure geographies, Cook Islands (Group, Island, Electoral Boundary, Census District, EA)" (cok-spc-pcrafi-2010-exposure-boundaries); Pacific Community (SPC) Statistics for Development Division / Cook Islands Statistics Office, "2011 Cook Islands Population and Housing Census administrative boundaries (EA, census district)" (cok-spc-sdd-phc2011-boundaries); Pacific Community (SPC), Geoscience, Energy and Maritime Division, "Global Exclusive Economic Zones (200 Nautical Miles) - Merged Dataset (SPC Pacific Maritime Boundaries)" (spc-gem-pacific-eez-200nm). Licences (per row in the `license` column): CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, CC-BY-4.0. Some rows are used and redistributed by this project under a data-use agreement (CSDR-SPC data use agreement (user-confirmed 2026-11-20)); downstream users are bound by the row's public licence (e.g. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) unless they hold their own agreement. Full provenance and source notes: https://github.com/SustainableDevelopmentReform/pacific-administrative-boundaries/blob/v0.1.0/docs/sources.md#cok-cook-islands.
